doc.name: Fido
doc.description: Scheduling built for sign language interpreting. Fido works your requests, jobs, interpreters, billing and reports in plain language, acting as the signed-in person and within their role. Actions that change records need the person's yes in the conversation: they appear as a request for approval, and nothing changes until the person (not the calling agent) says yes.

skills.name: Daily brief
skills.description: What needs attention today: unfilled jobs, conflicts, late items, and what changed since you last looked.

skills.name: Fill open work
skills.description: Find qualified, free interpreters for open jobs and broadcast or assign them (you approve each change).
examples: Who is free Thursday for a two-hour ASL job?
Fill the unassigned jobs for next week.

skills.name: Requests and jobs
skills.description: Look up, create, change and cancel interpreting requests and jobs.
examples: Show tomorrow's jobs at Memorial Hospital.

skills.name: Billing and payments
skills.description: Invoices, payables, payments and what is overdue.
examples: What do we owe providers this month?

skills.name: Reports
skills.description: Fill rate, hours, activity and receivables, with exports.
examples: What was our fill rate last month?

skills.name: People and credentials
skills.description: Providers, clients, consumers, and credentials that are expiring or missing.
examples: Which interpreters have credentials expiring this month?
Find the client record for Acme Health.
